production.note: US model years from 2022 (Ford's '2022 Ford Bronco Raptor' technical specifications). Still sold: Ford's US site lists a 2026 Bronco Raptor (ford-com-bronco-raptor).

body.note: 'Midsize four-door rugged 4x4 SUV' (the Raptor is four-door only).

configuration.note: '3.0-liter EcoBoost 60-degree V6, compacted graphite iron block, aluminum head'

displacementL.note: '180.0 cu. in.' (about 2,950 cc), bore x stroke '85.4 mm x 86.0 mm'.

fuel.note: The sheet lists SAE horsepower ratings for regular and premium fuel.

drivetrain.note: '2-speed transfer case with 4H, 4L and 4A mode for automatic on-demand engagement': a two-speed 4x4 system with low range.

powerHp.note: Ford's US website for the 2026 Bronco Raptor gives 418 hp maximum horsepower (read on ford.com by the project owner on 3 October 2026; the page does not render for the research tools). Ford's 2022 technical specifications printed 'SAE horsepower ... TBD'; the 418 hp / 440 lb-ft rating for the 2022 launch was announced by Ford CEO Jim Farley and reported by Motor1 (motor1-bronco-raptor-418). The rating has not changed since launch.

weightLb.note: Manufacturer curb weight, 2022 model year (the only body and transmission). Quote: 'Base curb weight 5,733 lbs.' No estimate label.

sources.publisher: Ford Motor Company (technical specifications reproduced by Bronco II Corral)
